notes.title: Experiences Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/164be69ca8b9101577fe9faf1e567c47018e20c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Experiences Update[/h3]

Dear Tamers,

We’re thrilled to announce a new update to Tomomon that’s all about enhancing your gameplay experience! Thanks to your continued support and feedback, we’ve made several improvements to make your journey through the Tomo World more immersive and enjoyable than ever.

🔧 What’s New in This Update:
🎮 Optimized Keyboard Controls
We've fine-tuned movement and control inputs to feel more responsive and natural across the board. Navigating menus and controlling your Tomomon is now more seamless on keyboard!

🖱️ Full Mouse Support Added
Prefer pointing and clicking? You can now play Tomomon entirely with your mouse – from exploration to battles to menu navigation. It’s a whole new way to experience the game!

📚 Polished Dialogue and Writing
Texts has been reviewed and improved for clarity, personality, and immersion. Characters now speak with more charm, and the story flows better than ever.

🔥 Now 35% Off During the Creature Collecting Festival!
If you haven’t joined the adventure yet, now’s the perfect time—Tomomon is 35% off as part of the Creature Collecting Festival on Steam! Don’t miss out!

This update is all about you – the player. Whether you're just starting out or diving back in, Tomomon now plays better, feels tighter, and reads smoother.

Thank you for continuing to support our journey. More content and features are on the way, so stay tuned and keep taming!

🐾 — The Tomomon Dev

notes.title: Major Update 0.93.x: Modify System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/cc6adf6dfed02a62b72f24b4dac7385dbe42fe84.jpg[/img]
[h2]Modify System[/h2]
Hello Tamers, today we would like to introduce to you a new feature of version update 0.93x: [b]the Modify System[/b].

This feature helps you enhance your Tomomon with new attributes such as adding [b]extra Stats[/b] or introducing [b]new skills[/b] to your creatures.

The feature is called the Modify Mods System and consists of three main components: [b]Mainboard[/b], [b]Chipsets[/b], and [b]Wordset[/b].

[h2]Mainboard[/h2]
[b]Mainboard[/b] is a main printed circuit board that can be equipped by your Tomomon (as equipment).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/5504e207893f153e6116533a3ee2c29acd11a61f.png[/img]
  - A Mainboard [b]contains empty slots[/b] for attaching [b]chipsets[/b].
  - Each Mainboard has a certain amount of [b]additional stats[/b] and a [b]different number of slots[/b] corresponding to the number of chipsets that can be equipped onto the mainboard.
  - Most Mainboards [b]can be purchased[/b] at the [b]Tech Shop[/b].

[h2]Chipsets[/h2]
Chipsets are small devices that can be set on a mainboard on your Tomomon, which will make them stronger. Each chip possesses its own unique stat boost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/e07bb0dbe49a79f7684ae32e7ef70417ae351451.png[/img]
[h3]There are four different types of chips:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b] Xyz chipsets[/b]: include one specific of the basic stat and one of three letters (X-Y-Z).
[*][b] Alphabet chipsets[/b]: add specific stats with a set quantity and contain one of the 26 letters of the Latin alphabet (26 chips).
[*] [b]Number chipsets[/b]: add specific stats with a set quantity and contain a number from 1 to 9 (10 chips).
[*][b] Special chipsets[/b]: SSR chipsets.
[/list]
- [b]Xyz [/b]chipsets can be [b]purchased[/b] in the [b]Tech Shop[/b].
- [b]Alphabet [/b], [b]Number [/b]and [b]Special [/b]chipsets only appear in the [b]Gacha System[/b].

[h2]Wordset[/h2]
When you [b]combine chipsets[/b] on the mainboard [b]in a specific order[/b], it will [b]activate an effect[/b] for your Monster. This effect can be a skill or specific additional stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/0da145cc7f193adeca0cd06ed97b83d90a2e47a0.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update 0.93.x: Gachapon Feature
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/0460063dca0262689b953ee712e2e224929c4df2.jpg[/img]
[h2]What is Gachapon System in Tomomon?[/h2]
The Gacha System is a new feature introduced to enhance players' experience in version 0.93.x.

[h3]Currently, the gacha machines consist of three types:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Item Gacha Machine (IG Machine)[/b]: consisting of 2 machines, randomly distributing craft materials, chips, consumable items at specific rates.
[*] [b]Skill Scroll Gacha Machine (SSG Machine)[/b]: comprising 2 machines used to randomly obtain skill scrolls for teaching skills to Tomomons.
[*] [b]Special Skill Scroll Gacha Machine (SSSG Machine)[/b]: featuring 1 machine that randomly distributes skill scrolls for teaching skills to Tomomons. However, this machine is the only one that grants skills with disabling effects.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=dkmBac_x8ks;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Gacha System utilizes 3 new currencies: Gold, Silver, and Blue Coins.[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Silver Coins[/b]: Used for the IG Machines, obtainable by capturing a Tomomon in Expedition mode.
[*] [b]Gold Coins[/b]: Used for the SSG Machines, obtainable by winning battles against NPCs in Expedition mode.
[*] [b]Blue Coins[/b]: Used for the Blue SSG Machine, obtainable by trading with an NPC selling soda at the Soda Stop in the Expedition Map. Exchange Rate: 1 Blue Coin = 30 Achievement Points.
[/list]
[b]IG Machines[/b] and [b]SSG Machines[/b] appear at the Soda Stop in the [b]Grassland Expedition map[/b]
[b]SSSG Machine[/b] appears at the Soda Stop in the [b]Snow Field[/b] & [b]Tropical Island Expedition maps[/b].

[h3]Other Relative Features:[/h3]
[b]Expedition Feature[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1979570/view/6002801934197612282]View[/url]
[b]Modify System[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1979570/view/6002801934197951032]View[/url]

notes.title: Major Update 0.93.x: Expedition Feature
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/435aebf01450d00fe36c00e3036fef403d87cc2c.jpg[/img]
[h2]What is Expedition Mode?[/h2]
Expedition Mode is specially introduced in Version 0.93.x
It's not just a normal expansion mode; in fact, it's one of the main features of the game.
Expedition is containing different maps with different features. Each map has its own different entry fee and can be unlocked at some point in the game.

[h2]So, what we can do in Expedition Mode?[/h2]
[h3]More Tomomons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/dee0fc2e9400aa1947af1ae0e96d195a0db40661.gif[/img]
- Hunting Tomomons with different types that can't be found in general Zento's biomes.
- ExoForms Hunting: In this mode, Tomomons with Exotic Form have a slightly higher chance to respawn by ugrading related perks in the Tamer Profile.

[h3]More Items[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/fc0e402ae583139c6f1b167267e175640cb42ed4.gif[/img]
- Finding & Gathering resources for crafting. 
(Currently, the crafting feature only has simple recipes like recovery items and simple quest items, but it will be updated more in the future.)
- Money & Items Farming: Chests and Items is well arranged in Expedition to serve as the rewards for Tamers in each run.

[h3]More Grinding[/h3]
- Tamer & Tomomon Trainning: In Expedition, tamer NPCs can be rebattled in each run, so it's a good option to train our tamer character and Tomomons here.

[h3]SodaStop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/8a7b428fc0ae0f267d169e9952990a91a8856331.gif[/img]
- Access the SodaStop: SodaStop is a special place to play Gacha and collect useful information.
- Access the Black Seller: This NPC can only be found in Expedition, and he is selling rare and useful items to enhance gameplay experiences.

Currently, there are 3 expedition maps that tamer can depart on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/f4acb9db1758ad2730d518dee70a07baef0cce7d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Overall, in order to progress the main storyline, expedition is one of the most important features for grinding and powering up to prepare for the next target in the mainlines.[/h3]

notes.title: Major Update 0.93.x: ExoForm Feature
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/8b900bf2188c5cd168dfe627379b4a1908870009.jpg[/img]
[h2]What is ExoForm Feature?[/h2]
ExoForm Feature is special appearances of Tomomons that have distinct visual differences compared to their normal counterparts. 
The primary distinction lies in their coloring; these unique appearances do not offer any statistical or strength-related advantages. Some variations exhibit completely different colors from the norm, while others have only minor changes in coloring.

There are three primary types of ExoForms:
[list]
[*] [b]Exotic:[/b] Special forms of all Tomomons.
[*] [b]Exolink:[/b] Unique forms of Fusion Tomomons that emerge when two Exotic Tomomons are combined using the Fusion feature.
[*] [b]Exodian:[/b] An even more special form than Exotic, exclusively found in Legendary Tomomons.
[/list]
[h3]Legendary ExoForm[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/22fe0a418029b139433709359631829f02f979ff.gif[/img]
[h3]Fusion ExoForm[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/0f8ba9e0c50b9d94eddb7cb4318d0b99d48c8c90.gif[/img]

[h2]Where to Find Them?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Normal Tomomons:[/b] Each time a Tomomon appears on the map, there's a certain chance it will appear in Exotic Form.
[*] [b]Fusion Tomomons:[/b] Combining one Normal Form and one Exotic Form results in an Exotic Fusion Monster. Combining two Exotic Tomomons through Fusion yields an Exolink Fusion Tomomon.
[*] [b]Legendary Tomomons:[/b] Each time they appear on the map, there's a chance they will appear in Exotic Form or Exodian Form (the probability of encountering Exodians is significantly lower than Exotics).
[/list]

Additionally, the Exotic Crystal can transform a Tomomon from Normal Form to Exotic Form (this item can be obtained in the Early Access Gift or through the Gacha System).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43803353/f2fa4c24b6bfdec3466fb939d43446f61057cd27.png[/img]

You can directly observe Exotic and Exodian Tomomons on the map due to their visible differences in appearance and visual effects without having to encounter them.

notes.title: Early Access - Launch Announcement
notes.content:
As of now, it has been two days since the Early Access version was launched, and this is the first official announcement from Tomomon.

In order to create a Monster Taming game world in the style of classic GBA games, and revive the old-school gaming experiences that still fit with current trends, the team has chosen to create the game title Tomomon. The graphics and gameplay are inspired by the classic GBA games, featuring pixel graphics and familiar gameplay mechanics

In summary, the first version of the game in Early Access is a build designed to showcase and guide players through the features that the team intends to include in the game. This build is not yet complete and can be seen as a kickstart for our game project.

In this [b]Early Access[/b] version, players can experience features such as: 
- [b]Monster Capturing[/b] with over 140 species (including Evolution and Fusion cases)
- [b]Evolution System[/b]
- [b]Fusion System[/b] with 9 cases (over 50 cases in the full game)
- About 18 maps (over 36 maps in the full game) with 10 different biomes (over 17 biomes in the full game)
- Normal Battles with Regular NPCs.

What will be included in the [b]Full-Release[/b]?
In our game, we plan to include a [b]World & Story Questline[/b] that will immerse players in the game's universe. We also aim to develop an [b]Immersive Battle System[/b] that includes a [b]Better Skill Match-up System[/b], making battles more exciting and challenging.

Furthermore, we will add many more [b]Monster Interaction Features[/b], such as [b]riding[/b], [b]surfing[/b], [b]feeding[/b], [b]racing mini-game[/b], ... We will also include a [b]Food and Item Crafting System[/b] that will allow players to create new items and enhance their monster's abilities.

To add a personal touch to the game, we plan to include [b]Personal House/Base Customization Features[/b], which will allow players to create a unique and personalized home for their character. Additionally, we will introduce [b]Rare and Super Rare Forms[/b] of monsters that players can encounter and capture, adding more depth and variety to the game.

Thank you for taking the time to follow our project. Although there are still some shortcomings, we hope to receive feedback from you.
